game.label: The folder with the exefs and romfs you extracted from your own copy of Kirby and the Forgotten Land for Nintendo Switch, version 1.0.0.

prepare.label: Translating the game code from your copy and compiling it for this PC. About 7 minutes on a 16-thread PC. Your game files are linked into this folder when they are on the same drive, and copied (about 6 GB) when they are not.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen fills your screen. Windowed opens the game in a window.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. Match the display uses your screen's resolution. The percentages are for slower graphics cards. 4K needs a fast one.

exit_codes.8: No exefs and romfs were found in that folder. The exefs holds main and main.npdm, the romfs holds the folders msg and gfx. Pick the folder you extracted them into.
exit_codes.9: That is a game package (.nsp or .xci), not extracted files. Extract them first with an emulator set up with your own keys. In Ryujinx: right-click the game, Extract Data, Extract ExeFS, and pick an empty folder; then Extract Data, Extract RomFS, into the same folder. If the game's update is installed there, choose No Update first (right-click the game, Manage Title Updates). Then pick that folder.
exit_codes.10: Those are not the files of Kirby and the Forgotten Land 1.0.0. They are from another game, or from a version of Kirby this release does not support. Extract version 1.0.0 of the base game.
exit_codes.11: The game files could not be copied. Check that the disk has about 6.5 GB free (a copy to another drive needs about 6 GB; on the same drive the files are linked and take no extra space).
exit_codes.12: The game code did not build. The log in the game's folder says why.
exit_codes.13: The build tools are missing from this copy. Install the recomp again.
exit_codes.14: The game's romfs could not be read. If you picked a romfs.bin, it is cut short or is not a plain RomFS image. Extract the romfs folder again and pick the folder that holds it.
exit_codes.15: That is the game's update, not the base game. Extract the base game, version 1.0.0, without the update.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The game's log, to send when something breaks.
